[EN] I saw several {@LinkCreature:22#18#vampir aristocrats} wandering the halls. They weren't invited to the festival and I can't help wondering if they played a role in this disaster!

The vampirs have proven dangerous recently. Take no chances and eliminate them.
[ES] Vi a varios {@LinkCreature:22#18#vampir aristocrats} deambulando por los pasillos. ¡No fueron invitados al festival y no puedo evitar preguntarme si tuvieron un papel en este desastre!

Los vampirs han demostrado ser peligrosos recientemente. No te arriesgues y elimínalos.

[EN] The Witches of Vadoma will owe you a great debt when this is over.

Our tradition stresses our collective strength, not reliance on outsiders.

When they're in their right minds again, perhaps we'll rethink that stance.
[ES] Las brujas de Vadoma te deberán una gran deuda cuando esto termine.

Nuestra tradición enfatiza nuestra fuerza colectiva, no depender de forasteros.

Cuando vuelvan a estar en su sano juicio, tal vez reconsidere esa postura.
